title: fix(ui): a multi-value field's list filter offers contains / does not contain, not the operators the server refuses
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Fixes #35559

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表里按多选字段(多选、复选框、标签、多值人员/查找)筛选时,条件只剩「包含 / 不包含 / 为空 / 不为空」,选一个值就能查出结果,不再弹出「该视图的查询被拒绝」;单选字段照旧。
- 为什么做:外部开发者反馈多选字段在列表里根本筛不了,服务器本来就支持「包含」,只是筛选面板一直没提供。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个多值字段的条件选项少了或多了一项,只影响列表筛选,不改数据,撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The list's two filter surfaces chose operators from the field TYPE alone, so a multi-value field offered operators the server refuses on a JSON column (`JSON_COLUMN_INCOMPATIBLE_OPERATORS`, `@objectstack/core`): picking a value sent `["f_multiselect","=","red"]` and the list showed the refusal. Both surfaces now read one helper keyed on the same two field facts the server's faces read (type and `multiple`, through the spec's `isMultiValueField` and `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES`):

- `@object-ui/components` `filter-builder.tsx`: new exported `jsonColumnFilterOperators(field)` and `operatorsForField(field)`. A multi-value field (`multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags`, or `select` / `radio` / `lookup` / `user` with `multiple: true`) offers `contains`, `not_contains`, `is_empty`, `is_not_empty`; a structured-JSON field offers `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` only; every other field keeps its type bucket. The row's own operator is always mounted, so a saved refused operator still shows and can be changed. `contains` on a multi-value option field draws a single-option picker (the spec's `$contains` takes one comparand; an array comparand is refused, measured below). "Add filter" and a field switch land on `contains` instead of `equals` for such a field. `FilterBuilder` field descriptors accept `multiple`; `emptyCheckArm` reads it too. `operatorsForFieldType` (what a row can HOLD, read by the dataset and flow inspectors) is unchanged.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` quick filter (`conditions/`): `quickFilterOperators(field)` = the same helper, else the family list. `FilterValuePanel` and the default operator read it.
- `ListView.tsx`: the filter field descriptors carry `multiple: field.multiple === true` (one line, claim amended by the seat), without which `select` / `lookup` / `user` with `multiple: true` cannot be told from single-value.

Read first, by risk:
1. `filter-builder.tsx` `offeredOperatorsForRow` / `jsonColumnFilterOperators` (the offer and the held-operator rule).
2. `filter-builder.tsx` `isOptionDrivenValueControl` (the value control for `contains` on a multi-value option field).
3. `conditions/conditionModel.ts` `quickFilterOperators`.

## Follow-up (nested under #35559)

- #35992: the dashboard filter bar (lowers a select/lookup global filter to `=` / `$in`) and the condition editors that build filter fields without `multiple` (FilterConditionField, Studio / metadata-admin condition rows). Both were found by reading and are outside this PR's surface.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins</summary>

- `components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-json-column-operators.test.tsx` (new): the helper per type and `multiple`; the dropdown on `select` with `multiple: true`, `multiselect`, `address`, single `select` (control); a stored `equals` still loads beside the four; `contains` draws a single-option Select; a field switch and "Add filter" land on `contains`.
- `plugin-list/src/conditions/__tests__/listConditions.test.tsx` (new top-level describe): every operator either surface offers for six multi-value fields and one structured field is lowered through the list's own `convertFilterGroupToAST` and the spec's `parseFilterAST`, and none of the resulting `$`-operators is in the server's `JSON_COLUMN_INCOMPATIBLE_OPERATORS` (read from `packages/core/src/utils/json-column-operator-refusal.ts`, with a lit control that `$eq` / `$in` are in it and `$contains` / `$empty` are not); control leg: equals / not equals / in / not in each reach a refused operator; 「包含」 sends `["responsibilities","contains","quality_lead"]` → `$contains`; single select unchanged; one pick replaces another; a saved refused operator still draws; zh-CN and en labels for both surfaces.
- `components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-empty-null-pair-11810.test.tsx`: the `multiselect` / `tags` case now pins the JSON-column offer (empty pair, no null pair to a fresh choice) and that a stored `is_null` still loads with the empty-list hint.

</details>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/ packages/plugin-list/` → Test Files 681 passed, 1 skipped (682); Tests 6774 passed, 24 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rerun 66 passed (exit 0).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Per-surface before / after, measured in the browser (showcase, zh-CN, 1280x800, `showcase_field_zoo`), and each server answer over REST:
  - Quick filter, `multiselect` / `checkboxes`: before 是其中之一 / 不是其中之一 / 为空 / 不为空, one pick sent `["f_multiselect","=","red"]` → 400 `INVALID_FILTER`, list showed 「该视图的查询被拒绝」; after 包含 / 不包含 / 为空 / 不为空, one pick sends `["f_multiselect","contains","red"]` → 200, 1 row.
  - Quick filter, `tags`: before 包含 / 不包含 / 等于 / 开头是 / 为空 / 不为空 (等于, 开头是 refused); after the four.
  - Quick filter, `user` with `multiple: true`: before 是其中之一 / 不是其中之一 / 为空 / 不为空; after the four.
  - Advanced panel (the shared `FilterBuilder`), `multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags`: before 等于 / 不等于 / 包含 / 包含（忽略大小写） / 不包含 / 为空 / 不为空 / 以…开头 / 以…结尾 / 为 null / 不为 null; `user` multiple: 等于 / 不等于 / 为空 / 不为空 / 属于 / 不属于; after the four on each.
  - Control, single `select`: unchanged on both surfaces (是其中之一 … / 等于 / 不等于 / 为空 / 不为空 / 属于 / 不属于), `["f_select","=","low"]` → 200.
  - REST on `multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags`: `=`, `!=`, `in`, `nin`, `startswith` → 400 `INVALID_FILTER`; `contains`, `notcontains`, `isempty`, `isnotempty` → 200; `contains` with an array value → 400, so `contains` names one member; an `or` of two `contains` → 200 (any-of is two rows under OR in the advanced panel).
- Surfaces that offer no operator per field, named: plugin-view `FilterUI` (writes values, no operator choice); the dashboard filter bar (writes values; its host lowers a `select` / `lookup` filter to bare equality or `$in` in `@object-ui/core` `dashboard-filters.ts` `buildFilterCondition`, outside this claim; not measured against a multi-value target); the `filter-builder` renderer forwards `FilterBuilderSchema.fields`, whose declared types (`FILTER_FIELD_TYPES`) and keys carry no multi-value type and no `multiple`, so it has no consumer of this offer.
- Other hosts of the shared builder (`FilterConditionField` in `@object-ui/fields`, the metadata-admin widgets) pass no `multiple`: they get the fix for `multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags` by type, and keep the type bucket for `select` / `lookup` / `user` with `multiple: true`. Outside this claim.
- A structured-JSON field is offered the empty pair only, not `contains`: the server's membership test is array-only, so `contains` on an object value would always answer no rows.
- The quick filter's option list keeps its checkbox rows for `contains`; a second pick replaces the first (listbox not multiselectable).

## Verification

Two minutes: in showcase, open 字段动物园, 筛选 → Multi-select. The operator reads 包含; tick Red; the list shows one record (Specimen — Full) and the chip reads 「Multi-select：包含 Red」.
